readme:
Fingerprint Cataloge

[![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/custombeta/Fingerprint-cataloge?label=Release&color=blue&logo=github)](https://github.com/custombeta/Fingerprint-cataloge/releases/latest) [![LSPosed](https://img.shields.io/badge/LSPosed-Module-orange?logo=data:image/svg+xml;base64,)](https://github.com/LSPosed/LSPosed) [![Telegram](https://img.shields.io/badge/Telegram-blue?logo=Telegram&logoColor=white)](https://t.me/duchamppower) Xposed module for HyperOS, for customizing fingerprint icons and animations. Allows you to create, download, import, and apply custom fingerprint icons. ## Compatibility | | Requirements | |------------------|------------------| | `LSPosed` | `API 101+` | | `Firmware` | `HyperOS 1+` | | `Android version`| `14+ (API 34+)` | ## Installation 1. Install the APK from [`Releases`](https://github.com/custombeta/Fingerprint-cataloge/releases/latest) 2. Activate the module in `LSPosed` ## Features - Built‑in library of fingerprint icons and animations - Create new icons from `.webp` images - Export fingerprint configurations - Import fingerprint configurations - Automatic update check - Support for app dynamic colors ## Screenshots | ![Screenshot1](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/custombeta/fingerprint-cataloge/refs/heads/main/assets/fingerprint-cataloge-default.png)| |------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------| | ![Screenshot2](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/custombeta/fingerprint-cataloge/refs/heads/main/assets/fingerprint-cataloge-monet.png) | ## Contacts Telegram: [`@custombeta`](https://t.me/custombeta) — bugs, questions, suggestions. > [!CAUTION] > The module only works on HyperOS. Use on other firmwares is not supported.
